posts.title: Ansible Collection Hardening & Restructuring: Config Cleanup, DNS Overhaul, and the Road to Samba AD
posts.summary: Ansible lab collection received focused updates: config bloat removed, DNS role restructured with Jinja2 templates, Jetson-Nano expanded. Three planning docs for Samba AD migration and 18-chapter lab manual.

posts.title: Tegra on the Edge: Why node90x Jetson Nanos Can't Talk to Their Own GPUs
posts.summary: Three Jetson Nano 2GB Developer Kits with Tegra T210 SoCs have inaccessible integrated GPUs — no nvidia-smi, no OpenCL, no CUDA runtime. Root cause analysis and remediation.
